overall.summary: Practice Fusion EHR exposes a broad native TSV export model with strong domain breadth and detailed field-level documentation, making the data operationally usable for migration. The main limitations are documentation depth rather than raw coverage: no formal relationship/constraint map, incomplete value-set specification, and no sample payloads. Overall this is a high-coverage native export that is usable with notable reconstruction assumptions.

notableFacts: v9 documentation explicitly states manual export supports both single-patient and entire-practice population workflows.
The parsed v9 dictionary contains 85 TSV entities and 1,165 documented fields.
Patient encounters include SOAP note components and addendum content, plus a psychotherapy-note indicator field.
Billing coverage is strong at superbill level (70 fields in patient-superbills.tsv) but downstream claim adjudication/payment posting artifacts are not clearly documented.
Patient messaging includes recipient and attachment tables with file-type and MIME metadata.
